    // Translate along +Z by `distance`.
    TranslateZ(self: IDeformable3D, distance: Number): Self
        => self.Translate(Vector3D.UnitZ * distance);

    // RESOLVED (was TODO(interface-gap): RotateAbout is omitted for the same reason as
    // IDeformable2D): the Transform(Vector3D, Quaternion) intrinsic rotates the pivot
    // displacement directly, so RotateAbout/Rotate/RotateX/Y/Z are implemented above.
